messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hi there! I’m having trouble sending MMS messages from my phone. It’s been happening for the past few hours, and I’d really like to get it working again. Can you help me figure out what’s going on?

To assist you with the MMS issue, I first need to identify you as a customer. Could you please provide me with your phone number, or your full name along with your date of birth? This will help me look up your account and check the relevant details.
Sure! My name is John Smith, and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any more information from me.

Thank you, John. I have identified your account. To troubleshoot the MMS sending issue, I will first check the status of your phone's cellular service and mobile data, as these are prerequisites for MMS to work. Then, I will check the MMS capability on your phone.

Your primary line (555-123-2001) is active, and your device is a Smartphone X, which is activated and eSIM capable. Next, I will check the status of your phone's cellular service and mobile data to diagnose the MMS issue.
It looks like my phone is currently in Airplane Mode. Could this be the reason why I can’t send MMS messages? What should I do next?

Yes, Airplane Mode disables all wireless communications, including cellular service and mobile data, which would prevent you from sending MMS messages.

Please turn off Airplane Mode on your phone. After that, let me know, and I can help you check if your MMS functionality is restored or if further troubleshooting is needed.

Airplane Mode is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📵 No Signal | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔋 80%
I've turned off Airplane Mode, but now my phone shows "No Signal" and "Data Disabled" in the status bar. What should I do next?

Since your phone shows "No Signal" and "Data Disabled," it means your phone is not connecting to the cellular network and mobile data is turned off. 

Let's start by checking the SIM card status to ensure it is properly recognized by your phone.

Your line is active and not suspended, so the issue is likely with the phone settings or SIM card. 

Please try to reseat your SIM card by removing it and reinserting it properly. This can help the phone recognize the SIM and restore signal. Let me know once you have done this.

SIM card re-seated successfully.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔋 80%
I've reinserted the SIM card. Now my phone shows a poor signal on 2G, and data is still disabled. What should I do next?

Since your phone is showing a poor signal on 2G and data is disabled, the next step is to enable mobile data on your phone. 

Please turn on mobile data on your phone. After that, let me know, and I will help you check the network mode preference to improve your connection.

Mobile Data is now ON.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
I've turned on mobile data. My phone still shows a poor signal on 2G, but data is now enabled. What should I do next?

Your phone is currently connected to a 2G network, which is not ideal for MMS and mobile data performance. 

The next step is to change your phone's network mode preference to allow connection to faster networks like 4G or 5G. 

I will guide you to set your network mode preference to "4g_5g_preferred" to improve your signal and data speed.
